description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
When Archon of Falling Stars dies, it triggers, returning Animate Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Animate Dead enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Animate Dead to it.
When Archon of Falling Stars enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
